newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse at lower levels.

text.p: 1301 GMT - German shares end bourse in negative territory, with any chance of the DAX index forging new significant gains undermined by a lack of inspirational data. Dealers look ahead to U.S. February payroll figures at 1330 GMT.
* DAX-30 index at 3,376.20 points, down 41.40 points.
* March DAX future at 3,380 points, down 20.
* Deutz top gainer in the session, ending up 24.23 percent at 10.51 marks on newsletter report that it will give upbeat forecast for current year results.
* Fresenius ends lower, but off lows, but pares earlier losses denying reports it plans to issue bonus shares.
